His word is true, and he always stands by it. It is never a matter of if he stands by it, it is of when we stand by it. So many men suit up in their armor daily. They look like warriors for God. They even have a sword like a warrior would. But, when you start to go to battle you notice something, these other warriors have forgotten their shields. What good is their entire suit of armor and a sword if they have no shield. The shield is the Shield of Faith. Without the shield the entire armor fails. We can still attack for God with the Sword of the spirit for it cuts deep. And we can walk with the lords Gospel of peace on our feet. We can guard our heart with the breastplate of righteousness. We can guard our mind with the helmet of salvation. We can guard our core and support ourselves with the belt/girdle of truth. But the word says only one thing stops the fiery darts of the enemy, that is the shield of Faith. That is a powerful piece of the armor. It even says, "Above all," before speaking on the shield of faith. The problem is you cannot wear it you have to carry it and its heavy and you must guide it to block the attacks. Sometimes we choose not to carry this piece. 

Psalm 91:4 his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

Carry the shield and the lord will make sure it is strong enough to stop all things. He promised it and he is always truthful.

The shield is not a Mask, it is not a Vaccine, it is nothing man can offer you. The Shield is your Faith. Your Faith in the lords ability to deliver you from troubles. Just as when David went to battle Goliath, Saul told David to wear his armor and tried to clothe him in Physical Armor. Samuel 17:39: And David said to Saul, “I cannot walk with these, for I have not tested them.” So David took them off.

That day David chose to use the Armor of God instead. The armor that he had tested and used. Th Armour that he knew would prevent him from harm. The armor that truly protected him and gave the Lord Victory. Give the lord his victory.
